title: Example code and data for channel smoothing and width estimation in the Oregon Coast Range
description:
This repository provides a simplified Python workflow and example datasets for analyzing channel and valley geometry from high-resolution topographic data in the Oregon Coast Range, Oregon, USA. The materials are associated with the study “Network-scale patterns of bedrock-channel sinuosity in the Oregon Coast Range” by Lin, Yanites, and Schanz.

The package includes:

  • smooth_channel_mini.py: A demonstration script for smoothing channel polylines and estimating median channel width (W50) and valley width (V50) from DEM cross-sections.

  • Yaquina_DEM_clip.tif: A high-resolution DEM subset from the Yaquina Basin.

  • Yaquina_channels_clip.gpkg: Example channel geometries from the Yaquina Basin.

  • README.md: Instructions describing input data, parameters, processing steps, and outputs.

  • requirements.txt: Python packages required to run the demonstration.

The script illustrates selected components of the channel-processing workflow and generates smoothed channel geometries, cross-sections, and stream-order summaries of channel and valley widths.

This repository is intended as a methodological demonstration rather than a complete reproduction package for all figures and statistical analyses presented in the manuscript.
